chunks.text: Today we will talk about Cameroon.
Cameroon is a colorful, diverse, and beautiful country in Central Africa.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Cameroon?
Cameroon is in Central Africa.
It borders Nigeria, Chad, Central African Republic, Republic of the Kong Kongo, Gabon, and Equatorial Guinea.
To the west, it touches the Atlantic Ocean.
Cameroon is often called Africa and Miniature because it has many different landscapes and cultures.
What is the capital city of Cameroon?
The capital city is Yaounde.
Yaounde is in the center of the country and has hills, government buildings, and markets.
The largest city is Duala, which is near the ocean.
Other cities include Garua, Bermuda, Bua, Marua.
How many people live in Cameroon?
About 28 million people live in Cameroon.
It is a multilingual and multi -ethnic country.
People live in cities, villages, and mountains.
What language do people speak in Cameroon?
Cameroon has two official languages, French, English.
People also speak over 200 local languages such as Fula Wando, Duala Bassa, Bakwari.
Many people speak more than one language.
What is the weather like in Cameroon?
Cameroon has different climates.
In the south, it is hot, humid, and rainy.
In the north, it is hot and dry.
In the mountains, it is cooler.
There are usually two seasons, the rainy season from May to October.
The dry season from November to April.
What does Cameroon look like?

Cameroon has rain forests in the south, mountains in the west, including Mount Cameroon, the highest in West Africa, savannas in the north, rivers, lakes, and waterfalls, beaches along the Atlantic coast.
It is a country of great natural beauty.
What animals live in Cameroon?
Cameroon has many animals, elephants, giraffes, and lions, gorillas, chimpanzees, and monkeys, antelope, buffalo, and hippos, crocodiles, birds, and insects.
Cameroon has many national parks and protected forests.
What do people eat in Cameroon?
Cameroonian food is rich, spicy, and varied.

People eat cassava, plantains, yams, and corn, rice, beans, and vegetables, fish, chicken, goat, or beef, popular dishes, and dole, bitter leaf stew with peanuts and meat or shrimp, arrow, vegetable stew with meat and fish, achu, yellow soup with cocoa yam, pulae dg, chicken with vegetables and plantains, koki, steamed beans and banana leaves.
What do people drink in Cameroon?
People drink water, palm wine, a natural drink from palm trees, fruit juices like pineapple, mango, or ginger.
Tea and coffee.
Adults may drink beer often brewed locally.
Palm wine is traditional and served at ceremonies or with guests.
What is life like in Cameroon?
Life in Cameroon is varied depending on where people live.
In cities, people work in offices, schools, or markets.
In villages, people farm, raise animals and live close to nature.
People enjoy spending time with family, music and dance, church or mosque, football, the national passion.
Cameroonians are proud of their culture and unity and diversity.
What are some holidays and traditions in Cameroon?
National Day, May 20.
Christmas and Easter for Christians.
Eid al -Feder and Eid al -Ah for Muslims.
Youth Day, February 11, New Year's Day.
Traditional festivals include dancing, drumming and colorful clothes.
People often wear traditional fabric and cook special food.
Some fun facts about Cameroon.
Cameroon is called Africa and Miniature.
It has over 250 ethnic groups.
Mount Cameroon is an active volcano.
Cameroon's football team is called the Indomitable Lions.
The flag is green, red and yellow with a star in the center.
Now you know many things about Cameroon.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about nature, culture, animals and daily life.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
